item.title: NYC congestion pricing cuts air pollution by a fifth in six months
item.description:
📝 This refutes claims that congestion pricing merely pushes traffic and its associated pollution to neighboring communities. Indeed, traffic data supports this. This tells us that congestion pricing didn’t simply relocate air pollution to the suburbs by rerouting traffic.
